notes: Kite: drift-nomads born in zero-g (standard rig). Long thin periwinkle limbs, a slim ribbed body with a cream belly, a small head with swept-back fins and huge round amber eyes, three long gripping toes and fingers, and a long prehensile tail with a hooked yellow tip behind (in the legs layer: it sways with the walk). The unarmed arms drift out wide. Head variants: wide, goggles (flight goggles with a tinted strap), helmet (a soft flight cap with ear flaps, tinted). Outfit mask = the cross-harness, the neck scarf, the cuffs, the goggle straps, the cap. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.
